scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const parts=fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>f.startsWith('source.part')).sort();const b64=parts.map(f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')).join('').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]/g,'');fs.writeFileSync('source.tgz',Buffer.from(b64,'base64'));" && tar -xzf source.tgz && next build
